about.what: Every world in the ELYND Worlds library on 3 Nov 2026 (1,101), exported from the engine's own per-world records (world.json trace, scene.json, verdict.json, cost.json). Pictures are not included.

runs.first: the first library, painted 26-27 Oct 2026 in batches (several worlds at once per machine); 443 of its worlds are in the library
runs.push: 19 daytime worlds for a push (energy) painted again 29-30 Oct 2026 with the place-alone painter; only summary fields were kept for these
runs.second: the second library, painted 2 Nov 2026 on two machines, 6 workers each with up to 3 worlds at once (CPU-bound): step times are much longer than for a single world

about.trace: [step, seconds, note]; each step's own duration. critique notes keep the critic's reason only for a painting that was turned down; regions notes name what SAM found and what it could not answer ('failed:'), recorded from the second library on
about.earlier: the verdict at creation when it came from muse-spark-1.3 (the open critic did not answer in time or in shape, so the engine fell back); Muse Spark Open judged these paintings again on 2 Nov 2026 and its verdict is the one in 'verdict'
